vehicles.description: Motor vehicles over 3.5 t technically permissible maximum mass: R2 two axles, R3 three, R4 more than three

network.description: The DARS motorway and expressway network, 129 toll sections; a section is charged when the route passes both of its ends. Not included: the 1.4 km Serminska vpadnica to the port of Koper. The Karavanke tunnel's Slovenian toll is a fixed amount per passage (Uredba o cestnini za uporabo cestnega predora Karavanke, Uradni list RS, št. 109/24 in 76/25, art. 3: R2 4.85, R3 5.38, R4 10.76 EUR excluding VAT).
